# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: player-only Space Race.
# Generated by tools/space_race_1970/compile.py; edit the compiler/catalogue.
on_actions = {
    on_startup = { effect = {
        every_country = {
            cw_sr_retire_antarctica = yes
            if = { limit = { is_ai = no IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
                cw_sr_seed_world = yes cw_sr_initialize = yes cw_sr_windows = yes
            }
        }
        random_country = { cw_sr_rank = yes }
    } }
    on_daily = { effect = {
        cw_sr_retire_antarctica = yes
        if = { limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
            cw_sr_initialize = yes
            if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cw_sr_last_rank_day = global.num_days } } }
                set_variable = { global.cw_sr_last_rank_day = global.num_days }
                cw_sr_seed_world = yes cw_sr_windows = yes cw_sr_rank = yes
            }
            cw_sr_daily = yes
        }
    } }
    on_weekly = { effect = { cw_sr_initialize = yes cw_sr_weekly = yes } }
}
